question: How does borg-reborn-rs main e5cc5469, with its own default settings, play the 999 saved encounters of Suite 1?
owner_authorization: 2026-11-19: the owner said "do all them" to a proposed sanity run of Suite 1 on main e5cc5469, after borg-reborn-rs shipped caution_scary_unlatch_calmed (#672) and the Phase Door rule (#662). Smoke first; later stages each after the previous stage's gate.
prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-19, before any result was read (borg-zoo#183). A sanity check of main: the 999 saves of
Suite 1 with its protocol (exact 2,000-engine-turn horizon, the suite's 30-second native wall limit, fresh Borg
memory, saved engine RNG). Settings: the checkout's own harness/borg.txt (sha256 6bf515d3...), nothing

the RNG, the borg-rs core, every borg.txt setting written, every borg_param_* effective from borg.txt, and an
initial pack/equipment/rune hash equal to the suite's. Reported alone: the death share, deaths per class and every
scenario's outcome. Encounters from one life are correlated.
